title: Explicit substantive book and source-state classifications from reviewed component evidence
semantics: Twenty-eight new book/source classifications and one replacement are integrated. The resulting 44 positive classifications describe bounded component differences, not 44 distinct whole books. Seven independently accepted act-component declarations are retained separately below so that normative acts do not inflate this book/source indicator.

review_files.storage: Disposable review packets remain outside Git; exact hashes pin their identities.

uses.scope: Placement of the intercession in the Coptic-Arabic Eucharistic book; exact altered words and first introduction date remain unresolved.

uses.scope: Creed structure in the celebrant Lyturgia, native p. 8; the complementary Ministerium is not promoted by this evidence.

uses.scope: Later-hand diptych layer of the Sinaitic Liturgiarium, not a second manuscript, Catholic approval, whole-book recension or admitted act-history station.
